_comment: Campaign-wide defaults for Run1B, applied by json2jobdef.load_json to
every entry the listed stage files contribute. The includes land ahead
of the entry's own overrides, so an entry that pins a value still wins:
the 42 frozen entries on geom_run1_b_v01/v03/v06 keep their geometry.
applies_to leaves out merge_filter, merge_beam_pileup and evntuple.
Those run artcat.fcl and the ntuple FCLs, which configure no
GeometryService at all -- a geometry default there would construct a
service the job has no use for.
dsconf_prefix is load-bearing: data/Run1B also holds 15 MDC2025*
entries, which must not take a Run1B detector configuration.
